project.PROJECT_NAME: STELE masonry & timber fence — Buffalo NY
project.UNIT_POLICY: Internal millimetres. Convert only at drawing/CSV inch columns.
project.DESIGN_STANDARD: Buffalo Green Code + ASCE 7 wind; frost per Erie County
project.MATERIAL_SYSTEM: Cast stone / air-entrained concrete + western red cedar
project.TOLERANCE_CLASS: T1 general woodworking / T2 joinery pockets / T3 templates
project.AUTHOR: HASHIRA/STELE fabrication model
project.CONFIGURATION: STANDARD — 4 panel bays + 1 Roman arch gate

parts.PROCESS: Cast in place, (3)#4 EW bottom 75 cover, (4)#4 vert into stem
parts.NOTES: Bearing at −frost_depth on F-003. Pour monolithic with F-002 where possible.

parts.PROCESS: Cast; #3 ties @ 300; damp-proof top 150
parts.NOTES: Capillary-break flashing at stem/plinth. CONSTRAINT: FIXED to F-001.

parts.PROCESS: Compacted in 75 mm lifts
parts.NOTES: Roman rule: never let the base sit wet.

parts.PROCESS: Cast / dressed; Type S bed
parts.NOTES: Sits on flashing over F-002.

parts.PROCESS: Battered drums + pocket cores; epoxy #4 dowels
parts.NOTES: Batter 60/1600 = 1:26.7 per face (Egyptian talus). GATE_L + END_R.

parts.PROCESS: Battered drums + pocket cores; epoxy #4 dowels
parts.NOTES: END_L + GATE_R. Mirror of M-002-L.

parts.PROCESS: Battered drums + pocket cores both faces
parts.NOTES: MID piers. Same batter as M-002-L/R.

parts.PROCESS: Three units: tier1 560×50, tier2 470×55, pyramid 380→180×110
parts.NOTES: Drip kerf 8×8, 20 from edge, all 4 sides of tiers 1+2. 1:12 wash min.

parts.PROCESS: Dressed bed + springer seat
parts.NOTES: Arch bears here in pure compression. SS dowels for erection only.

parts.PROCESS: Cast to T-501 template; radial joints 10 mm Type S
parts.NOTES: Flat soffit on impost. L/R mirrored.

parts.PROCESS: Cast to T-502; identical if equally divided ring
parts.NOTES: Concentric ring — all typical voussoirs IDENTICAL.

parts.PROCESS: Tapered loft key_b→key_t; proud 30 ea face
parts.NOTES: Do not strike centering until 7-day cure after key is set.

parts.PROCESS: Cast; (2)#4 cont.; thickened edge 300 deep at ends — DOES NOT tie to pier ftgs
parts.NOTES: CONSTRAINT: FLOATING — heave isolation from piers.

parts.PROCESS: Joint/plane to 38×89; final crosscut to stop S-014
parts.JOINERY: Nuki 貫 through M-002 pockets; W-001 wedges both ends
parts.NOTES: All 12 IDENTICAL. Purchase 2×4×8' S4S. Datum End = left pocket engagement.
parts.FINISH: End-grain oil; faces weather to silver

parts.PROCESS: Rip 1x6; final crosscut stop S-015; 2× SS nails per rail crossing
parts.JOINERY: Fastened to R-001 only — never into masonry
parts.NOTES: CONSTRAINT: FLOATING (nailed to rails; rails float in pockets). 10 mm gaps.

parts.PROCESS: Rip; plane 8° wash (street face high); drip kerf both long edges
parts.NOTES: Washes water off rain-screen. Do not caulk kerfs.

parts.PROCESS: Rip taper ~1:12; drive from weather side so rain tightens
parts.NOTES: Harder than cedar frame. Replaceable. Do not glue.

parts.PROCESS: Mortise for ledges; hinge-stile gets H-002 layout from Datum End 0
parts.JOINERY: Hozo ほぞ into ledges, drawbore optional
parts.NOTES: Hinge stile = street-left as viewed from outside, inward swing.

parts.PROCESS: Tenon both ends; three IDENTICAL
Cut to T-503; rises from HINGE side
parts.NOTES: Brace must rise from hinge (bottom) to latch (top). Reverse = sag.

parts.PROCESS: Rip; nail to ledges SS
See HASHIRA guide
parts.NOTES: HASHIRA system for existing-fence reinforcement — not used in STELE (masonry piers replace posts).
parts.MATERIAL: Western red cedar / black locust / white oak

decisions.DECISION: Masonry piers replace timber posts in STELE
decisions.REASON: Buffalo frost + plow berms destroy grade-set posts; mass + batter resists 115 mph without straps.
decisions.AFFECTED: All M-*, F-*; L-001 optional HASHIRA-only

decisions.REASON: Seasonal movement of 2080 mm cedar; glue would split mortise cheeks. Wedges are the lock and the repair path.

decisions.DECISION: Tenon thickness = ⅓ of 40 mm stile ≈ 13 mm
decisions.REASON: Mortise cheek thickness remains adequate in GS-001.

decisions.DECISION: Curb FLOATING independent of pier footings
decisions.REASON: Shallow curb will heave; continuity would rack piers.

decisions.DECISION: Arch in pure compression, no structural steel
decisions.REASON: Freeze-thaw attacks tension; Roman geometry removes it. SS dowels are erection-only.

decisions.DECISION: Panel top 1825 mm under 6′-0″ residential limit
decisions.REASON: Green Code. Pier caps 1965 and arch 2640 assessed separately — TO BE CONFIRMED with Permit & Inspection.

fmea.MITIGATION: 48″ bearing + F-003 drain + AE concrete + QC-02/03
Mass rule ≥3× reaction; batter keeps resultant in middle third
7-day hold QC-10; imposts sized; Type S
Sacrificial masonry curb; boards replaceable bay-by-bay

build_sequence: Cure 7 d; flashing H-007; M-001 plinths
M-002 drums to batter stick; core pockets from story stick
Mill R-001 lot on stop S-014; W-001
Dry-fit all rails J-N*; wedge weather-side
M-004 imposts; timber centering; M-005/006/007; 7-day hold
Strike centering; A-LEAF dry diagonals; hang H-002/H-003
Final QA walk, oil end grain H-008
